response.sql: WITH hof_by_state AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_state, 'Missing') as death_state, COUNT(*) as hof_count FROM player p INNER JOIN hall_of_fame hof ON p.player_id = hof.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.death_state, 'Missing')), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(hof_count) as overall_avg FROM hof_by_state) SELECT AVG(hbs.hof_count) as avg_count, AVG(hbs.hof_count) - oa.overall_avg as above_average_amount FROM hof_by_state hbs CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE hbs.hof_count > oa.overall_avg
